authorization_ts.description: The time at which the transaction was authorized in RFC3339 format. UTC if possible.

byn_transaction_id.description: The Banyan ID generated for the transaction

custom_fields.description: Set of custom fields set on the transaction.

finx_consumer_token.description: The merchant's token for the consumer.

finx_transaction_id.description: The finx's internal ID for the transaction.

purchase_ts.description: The time at which purchase occurred in RFC3339 format. UTC if possible.

received_ts.description: The time at which the receipt was received in RFC3339. UTC if possible.

address_line_one.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

address_line_two.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

city.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

country.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

postal_code.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

state.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

display_name.description: The banner name of the store of the purchase.

name.description: The legal/listed name of the store of the purchase.

phone_number.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

arn.description: A unique 23-digit number that tags a credit or debit card transaction when it goes from the merchant's bank to the cardholder's bank. Also called a trace ID.

auth_code.description: Six digit alphanumeric code passed between banks that signal a transaction is possible.

bin.description: Bank Identification Number associated with the card used. Some BINs will be 8 digits in the near future.

card_issuer.description: The card issuer for the card used on this payment.

card_last_four.description: Last 4 digits on the debit/credit card.

card_type.description: Card Type refers to the type of card offering from the card issuer.

finx_mid.description: A unique ID for each POS, assigned by the finx.

payment_type.description: Credit card vs debit card transaction.

scheme.description: The network the card was issued on.

virtual_card_last_four.description: The last four digits of the virtual card used for the transaction.
